question: Can an event-preserving guitar model fit a handful of its own training examples, including repeated same-fret attacks?

proposedScope.selection: Freeze a deterministic metadata-only selection rule within the existing accepted P1 population before opening examples. Do not cherry-pick using model outputs. Report missing repeated-attack coverage explicitly.

proposedInitialization.note: Preserves the existing random-init boundary. Reusing a V5 encoder would be a separately specified alternative, not an automatic fallback.

proposedDiagnostics: unweighted loss per head and fixed loss weights
matched offset MAE and within-tolerance count
no-event false positives on a separate synthetic silence fixture
stop reason and unresolved label counts

proposedAdvancement.meaning: Engineering learnability screen only; thresholds must be frozen before execution. Passing is permission to assess a next pilot, not proof of generalization or customer eligibility.
proposedAdvancement.onFailure: Stop this candidate, retain evidence, investigate inputs/targets/objective. No automatic extra epochs or new architecture. A budget-limited miss is not proof of impossibility.
